title: fix(service-datasource)!: refuse creating a datasource named `drivers`, the driver-catalog route literal
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi94YCYBg2S8baVHuFe3JkctW)_

Fixes #29164

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：新建运行时数据源时拒绝名字 `drivers`（与 `default` 同样的 400 `DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR`，报错点名该名字）；保留名单与路由注册用同一个常量，并有一条从注册器实际挂载推导的漂移测试。
- **为什么改**：`GET /datasources/drivers` 是驱动目录，先于 `GET /datasources/:name` 挂载，所以叫 `drivers` 的数据源能建、能列，但编辑表单永远打不开。
- **风险与回滚**：低。以前 201 的 `drivers` 创建现在 400（收窄）；`test` 仍可创建；已存的 `drivers` 行不受影响。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`datasource-route-reserved-names.ts`（名单与理由），`datasource-admin-service.ts` 的 `assertValidName`，`__tests__/datasource-route-reserved-names.test.ts` 的漂移测试。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-datasource exec vitest run src/__tests__/datasource-route-reserved-names.test.ts`，预期 `Tests 7 passed (7)`（main 上 `drivers` 用例红：expected 201 to be 400）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- New `src/datasource-route-reserved-names.ts` holds `DRIVER_CATALOG_SEGMENT` and `ROUTE_SHADOWED_DATASOURCE_NAMES` (today `['drivers']`): every literal segment the admin registrar mounts beside a same-method `/datasources/:name` route. Internal module, not exported from the package entry.
- `admin-routes.ts` mounts the driver catalog from that constant (`${root}/${DRIVER_CATALOG_SEGMENT}`); the wire path is unchanged.
- `assertValidName` (`datasource-admin-service.ts`) refuses each listed name after the existing `default` check, with the same thrown `Error`, so the route answers the same 400 `DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR`. The message names the reserved name. No new error code, status or member.
- Changeset `.changeset/29164-reserve-route-shadowed-datasource-names.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/service-datasource`, BREAKING banner, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, both declaration lines.

**Which literals shadow a name (measured on the registrar).** Single-segment literals under `/datasources` are `GET /drivers` and `POST /test`. `/:name` routes exist for GET, PATCH and DELETE only. So `drivers` shadows `GET /:name`; `test` shadows nothing (there is no `POST /:name`; the saved-datasource probe is `POST /:name/test`, a different depth). `test` is therefore not reserved, and a test pins that a datasource named `test` is created (201) and read back by name (200).

## Tests

New file `src/__tests__/datasource-route-reserved-names.test.ts` (7 cases). No existing test was edited.

- **Drift pin:** runs `registerDatasourceAdminRoutes` against a capturing mock `IHttpServer` (the route-ledger conformance seam), derives the literal single segments that share a method with a `/:name` route, and requires `ROUTE_SHADOWED_DATASOURCE_NAMES` to equal that set. A control asserts the enumeration saw `GET /:name` and `POST /test`. A second case pins the derivation itself: `POST /test` beside `GET /:name` derives nothing, `GET /test` beside it derives `test`.
- **Door cases** over the real `HonoHttpServer` and a real `DatasourceAdminService`: `drivers` → 400 `DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR`, message names `'drivers'`, nothing written; `default` → same refusal, unchanged; `reporting` → 201 and read back by name; `test` → 201 and read back by name.
- **Stored row:** a `drivers` row seeded in the store stays listed, patchable and removable.

<details><summary>Red on base, green on head, three ablations</summary>

- **Red** (tests committed first, fix absent, `41bae08f`): `Tests 2 failed | 5 passed (7)`; `drivers` create: "expected 201 to be 400". (The second red was the stored-row case asserting 200 on a DELETE that answers 204; the case now asserts `ok`. Not a behaviour change.)
- **Green** (`f085c3c6`): `Tests 7 passed (7)`.
- Every ablation ran through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor must hit, blob hashes, restore checked against HEAD). The test imports the service and registrar from source (relative paths), so no build sits between mutation and run.
- **Ablation 1:** the new guard became `if (false && ROUTE_SHADOWED_DATASOURCE_NAMES.includes(name))`, anchor 1 → 0, blob `4ec99504` → `4226d0f7`. Result `Tests 1 failed | 6 passed (7)`: the `drivers` refusal case, "expected 201 to be 400". Restored blob `4ec99504` = HEAD.
- **Ablation 2:** the `default` guard became `if (false && name === 'default')`, blob `4ec99504` → `fd350350`. Result `Tests 1 failed | 6 passed (7)`: the `default` case, "expected 201 to be 400". Restored = HEAD.
- **Ablation 3 (drift pin):** mounted an unreserved `GET ${root}/health` in `admin-routes.ts`, blob `b77801e2` → `214d385c`. Result `Tests 1 failed | 6 passed (7)`: "expected [ 'drivers' ] to deeply equal [ 'drivers', 'health' ]". Restored blob `b77801e2` = HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. A first attempt with an anchor the replacement repeated was refused by the tool (anchor count 1 → 1) and restored; it did not run.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Stored `drivers` rows.** The refusal is at create only, and an update cannot rename (it keeps `existing.name`). A row created before this release stays listed, patchable, removable and probe-able by name; its detail read still answers the catalog. Fixing that read would mean the catalog route resolving a datasource too, a second meaning on one path, so it is left out of scope. The changeset gives the remedy: recreate under another name, rebind the objects, remove the old row.
- **Code-declared datasources.** The spec's `DatasourceSchema.name` rule (`/^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$/`) also accepts `drivers`, so a datasource declared in code under that name hits the same shadowed detail read. That is the metadata accept surface, spec-lane work, so it is not touched here; it is reported to the seat.
- **Only `GET /drivers` is reserved.** Reserving `test` too would refuse a common name that today works through every door. The drift pin reserves it the day a same-method `/:name` sibling mounts.
